hooks.name: auto-validate-go-and-terraform
hooks.description: Validate Go tests and Terraform formatting and configuration when the agent stops.

action.command:
status=0

if find app -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.go' -print -quit 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then
  if ! (cd app && go test ./...); then
    echo 'Go validation failed: cd app && go test ./...' >&2
    status=1
  fi
else
  echo 'Go validation skipped: no app/*.go files found.'
fi

if find infra -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.tf' -print -quit 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then
  if ! (cd infra && terraform fmt -check); then
    echo 'Terraform format validation failed: cd infra && terraform fmt -check' >&2
    status=1
  fi

  if ! (cd infra && terraform validate); then
    echo 'Terraform configuration validation failed: cd infra && terraform validate' >&2
    status=1
  fi
else
  echo 'Terraform validation skipped: no infra/*.tf files found.'
fi

exit "$status"
